name: Hana Lee
source:
Hana Lee, a character in The Royal Romance and The Royal Heir series, is one of the suitors to [url=/c86785/]Liam Rys[/url] and a potential love interest for Your Character. She is first seen in The Royal Romance, Book 1, Chapter 1.

Hana is a kind-hearted girl with an endearing personality, although she is often shy, timid, and self-deprecating. [spoiler]As she matures and discovers her own interests outside of her family's, she becomes more confident and her own person.[/spoiler] She also can be very competitive.

Your Character first meets Hana in Chapter 2 at the boutique where Your Character is looking for a dress for the Masquerade Ball. She walks in and accidentally sees Hana in her underwear; depending on what the player chooses, Your Character can gain relationship or romance points with her. During Book 1 the two become friends, although the extent of the friendship is dependent on the player's choices. She helps Your Character navigate through courtly decorum and procedures, admitting in Chapter 7's premium scene that [spoiler]her parents suggested getting close to Your Character as a way to help her get close to Liam and become part of his inner circle[/spoiler]. Regardless of their feelings, Hana tells Your Character that she enjoys spending time with her and later becomes downhearted at the prospect of Your Character marrying Liam and [spoiler]her being labeled a failure again by her parents[/spoiler].

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Hana_Lee]Wiki[/url]]
